title: Implementing directly with the provider SDK

videos.script: Everything the last five lessons measured, in one file, with the provider's own SDK. {{file}} The question is embedded by the provider, the database finds the chunks, and the provider writes the answer. {{run}} Switch to Anthropic's API, and the citations come back as structure: which document, which characters. {{claude}} Stream the reply, and the first words appear while the rest is still being written. The search still has to finish first. {{stream}} Then the failures. Two refusals from the provider, and the SDK quietly tries again. Five, and the program has to decide what the customer sees. {{errors}} Count the tokens before sending, and drop the weakest source when the budget runs out. {{budget}} And write one line for every query, saying what was asked, what was found, and what it cost. {{log}} No framework. Every line is a decision you can point at a measurement for. {{end}}
